single_asset.zh: 本轮只交付 selection 指定的一个资产。用原文和目录作证据，按指定类型和标准名写入对应数组，其余数组为空。保留必要设计细节与指定形态，用精练措辞避免重复。所有分项完成后由系统核对全章。
single_asset.en: Deliver only the one asset specified by selection. Use the source and catalog as evidence. Use its exact category and canonical name in the matching array, leaving the other arrays empty. Preserve required design details and requested variants; avoid repetition. The whole chapter is checked after all entries have been assembled.

targeted_cast_instructions.zh: 清点依据是本次导演剧本，quote 摘自剧本。小说原文只补已出镜资产的外观。本次是定点补漏，覆盖整章清点范围：阅读本章以确定 target_requirements 指定的对象，包括“主角的剑”等关系称呼，只返回这些对象，不顺带提取其主人、其他场景或道具。逐项提供能证明该对象身份的准确原文，不能用无关引文凑数；有目录身份时使用标准名和 ID。根据剧本核对指定对象，无依据时返回空数组。对已登记的点名对象可补资料，实际出场按场次记。
targeted_cast_instructions.en: Use the director's screenplay for presence and quote evidence. Use the novel only for visual details of depicted assets. This is a targeted omission check, overriding the complete-chapter inventory scope. Read the chapter to resolve ONLY the objects specified in target_requirements, including relational references such as the protagonist’s sword. Do not include their owner or other locations/props. Use exact source quotes and registered names/IDs. An arbitrary unrelated quote is not identity evidence. Never invent a missing object. Return empty arrays if no requested object has source evidence. A named existing asset may be completed separately; record appearances from depicted scenes.

targeted_design_instructions.zh: 只生成已经通过原文核对的 required_asset_names，不增加主人或本章其他资产；提供具体的视觉设计。已有合格设计由服务器保留。本次补漏不授权新增衍生形态。
targeted_design_instructions.en: Generate only the source-verified required_asset_names. Do not add owners or other chapter assets. Provide concrete visual designs. Existing accepted designs are retained by the server. This omission request does not authorize new appearance variants.

render_cast_instructions.zh: 清点依据是本次导演剧本，quote 摘自剧本。小说原文只补已出镜资产的外观。独立完整阅读本章，按三个数组清点全部视觉资产：characters 是角色、动物与群像，scenes 是实际演出的场景，items 是可视化道具。列出每个有动作、对白或被具体演出的角色、动物与群像。presence 区分 present（当前实际出场）、flashback（真正演出的回忆、梦境或闪回）、mentioned（仅在对白或背景中被提及）。不能因为配角只出现一次就遗漏；已去世者在回忆中演出仍算出场。每项必须提供能够判断身份和出场性质的短段准确原文 quote，不改写引文。同一人的别名合并，不能因师父、宗主等头衔相同而合并不同人。不同类型资产允许同名或共用别名，只能在同一类型内匹配目录身份，不能跨类型合并或替代。可匹配目录身份时使用准确标准名和 existing_asset_id；新角色 ID 为 null。姓名保持原文语言。屏幕、半透明面板、界面等可视载体归 items，不归 characters；没有可见形体的提示音、画外声音和抽象概念标为 voice_only，不强制生成人物外形。按原文证据分类，不按名称一刀切：有实际可见身体的拟人系统仍可归人物。本章实际演出的场景、可见道具即使未登记也必须逐项列出，不能只清点人物。未命名说话者使用原文可区分的身份称呼，不编造姓名。返回 characters/scenes/items，本章确实没有该类资产时才用空数组，不生成视觉设定。
render_cast_instructions.en: Use the director's screenplay for presence and quote evidence. Use the novel only for visual details of depicted assets. Read the entire chapter independently and inventory all visual assets in three separate arrays: characters (people, animals and groups), scenes (depicted locations), and items (visible props). Include each character with an action, spoken line or depicted presence. Classify presence as present, flashback (including enacted memories/dreams), or mentioned (background/name references only). Do not exclude a supporting character just because they appear once. Death does not exclude an enacted flashback. Include a short exact source quote for each classification. Merge aliases for the same identity; never merge different people sharing a title. Different asset categories may share a name or alias. Resolve catalog identities only within the same category. Reuse the exact registered name and ID when identifiable; use null ID for a new character. Preserve source-language names. Visible screens, holographic panels and interfaces belong in items, not characters; a bodiless voice or abstract concept has presence=voice_only and needs no visual asset. Classify by the source evidence, not the entity name: a system with an actual depicted body may be a character. List every depicted location and visible prop, even when no catalog entry exists. Do not invent personal names for unnamed speakers; use a distinct source-supported role. Return characters/scenes/items, with [] only for types absent from the chapter; no visual design prompts.

render_cast_scope.zh: 按必需名单给定的类型逐项完成：1=人物、2=场景、3=道具，不能把已输出的道具或场景当成缺失人物。包括新出场与回忆中演出的角色、本章实际场景和可见道具；仅被提及者不新建资产，但已经登记且要求补全的占位资产仍须补全。
render_cast_scope.en: Complete every required asset in its listed category: 1=person, 2=scene, 3=item. Do not treat an item or a scene as a missing person. Include all new visible assets and flashback characters. Mention-only entries do not require a new asset unless already registered for placeholder completion.

render_asset_repair.zh: 只返回下列缺失或未通过校验的资产。合格资产已由服务器保留，不要重复生成或改写；仍使用 persons/scenes/items 三个数组，无需修正的类型返回 []。补全项使用目录标准名和具体视觉提示词；本章关联的占位资产即使仅被提及也必须补全。
render_asset_repair.en: Return only the missing or invalid assets listed below. Accepted assets are retained by the server; do not repeat or rewrite them. Keep the persons/scenes/items arrays, using [] where no repair is needed. Use the exact registered names and concrete visual prompts for repaired entries. A missing registered placeholder must be completed even if it is only mentioned in the chapter.
